subtitle: Prepare • Practice • Master.
instructions: 1. Read each question carefully before selecting your answer.
2. Choose the best answer from the four choices: A, B, C, or D.
3. Answer all 150 items. Do not leave any question unanswered.
4. For questions that require computation, show your solution or compute carefully before choosing your answer.
5. For analytical and reasoning questions, analyze the given information first and eliminate choices that do not satisfy the conditions.
6. Manage your time wisely. Avoid spending too much time on a single question.
7. If you are unsure of an answer, eliminate the clearly incorrect choices and choose the best remaining answer.
8. Do not look at the Answer Key until you have completed the mock examination.
9. After finishing, check your answers and review the questions you got wrong.
10. Use this mock exam to identify your strengths and areas that need improvement.
